source_class: user annotated rear photograph plus physical post dimensions, M2.5 screw-fit confirmation, thread-depth measurement, flat-plate coplanarity check, prior DSI506 geometry and FFC measurements
proposal: Mount the Pajoniiir-M1 custom mainboard directly to the four inner rear threaded posts on the display module, parallel to the display rear PCB.

mount_pattern.flat_plate_collision_check: PASS__all_four_post_tops contact and no display component touches the seating plane
mount_pattern.board_hole_pattern_policy: Use the exact 58 x 49 mm four-hole datum as the primary display-relative M1 mainboard mount frame.

screw_baseline.m2p5x5_policy: DO_NOT_USE with the 1.6 mm bare-PCB baseline because nominal engagement would be 3.4 mm against a measured 3.0 mm usable depth
screw_baseline.head_or_washer_status: OPEN_DETAIL__recheck engagement if washer thickness is introduced

ffc.routing_concept: Use a controlled U-bend near the right edge to a display-facing host DSI receptacle on the directly mounted mainboard. Final bend radius, host XY and service-removal keepout remain open.

mainboard_orientation.display_facing_side_policy: Keep substantially component-free; permit only deliberately validated low-profile parts in known-clear regions.

closed_by_b2: 1.6 mm mainboard rear surface Z=11.6 mm
M2.5 x 4 mm Rev-A screw-length baseline
remaining_before_outline_freeze: final NPTH clearance-hole diameter and screw-head/washer geometry
local obstruction map outside the four-post convex hull where the PCB may overhang
60 mm FFC bend radius, host connector XY and insertion/removal keepout
display receptacle pin-1 to host pin-1 proof
user-I/O connector wall assignments and cutout datums
final enclosure depth and rear-cover clearance
